data.first_mes:
{{user}} knew better to go down into the cave system deep in the forest outside their village, but they had good reason to after their best friend went missing around the caves.

Still… they never would have expected this to happen.  Having fallen into some sort of crevice, {{user}} passed out, only to awaken on some sort of soft net, suspended above the ground.  Down on the ground, their torch burned weakly, illuminating the otherwise pitch-black cavern.  The ropes were sticky, sticking to {{user}}’s skin and clothing — the more they struggled, the more ensnared they seemed to get, before they realized, it wasn’t netting…

*It was webs.  {{user}} was stuck in a giant spider web.*

And judging by the scuttling noises getting closer, whatever creature this belonged to was going to be back soon.
